outcomes.observation: The blank card travels from a torn advertising strip but stops at a coral boundary before the phone, conveying a pause before installation without saying a message infects a phone.
Cyan, coral, magenta, navy and halftone texture match the cited adult editorial print direction.
No people, hands, characters, named town elements or provider identity appear.
Phone, paper card, tabletop and background props are visually coherent; no anatomy is present.
No readable text, logos, labels, fake UI panels, arrows, checkmarks or badges appear.
Contemporary tabletop objects only; no wardrobe or historical claim.
Advertising strip, card, boundary and phone carry the source-and-installation decision; books and leaves do not claim a product behavior.
At 720px and 360px, the phone, app card and coral boundary remain distinct enough to carry the pause metaphor.

limitations: The boundary is an editorial metaphor, not software protection or an Android UI.
